_about: WHAT A ZONE IS FILLED WITH (arch/assemble.js part type `zone`): a church or hall marks floor areas by what belongs there -- `zone` the rule's name here, `w` across (the zone's z), `d` deep (its x), `h` the headroom, `at` its centre and turn, its +x THE WAY THE FURNITURE FACES (toward the altar) -- and the rule puts the furniture in: `one` thing at the centre (a component of assets/architecture or an item of assets/items, `yaw` turned, `params` as expressions over w, d, h), or `rows` of a component across the zone (`pitch` apart along x, from the back, `margin` kept free at the sides, split by an `aisle` when the zone is wider than `aisleOver`; L is a row's length)
